question: Can a history-disjoint 64-row v22 bank serve as the untouched confirmation corpus for the reader-contracted writer circuit selected only from v15/v20/v21?
evidence_status: Prospective native-capability gate. No v22 intervention, M11 state, reader, factor, subspace, component, rank, dose, or causal outcome has been opened.

searched: all aspectual/is-was builders v1-v21 and their row/reporter/text inventories
all native capability screens through v21
the v20 H/R split/state/gain results and the invalid v21 exhaustive atlas audit
prior_art.known_lessons: Capability must precede causal access. V21 is now discovery-only because its union-control registration was contradictory and raw H conflated capability with downstream use. A corrected selected-set test therefore requires rows absent from every selection artifact.
prior_art.novelty: All 64 row IDs, 16 reporter nouns, and every A1/A2/P target text are disjoint from v1-v21. The temporal surfaces intentionally match v21 so the new uncertainty is lexical generalization of the selected mechanism, not a simultaneously changed construction.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides; only native next-token correctness is computed.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder hash, row digest, full-history row/reporter/text disjointness, construction checks, and exact 16x4 inventory pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each A panel has at least 12 of 16 rows whose native base and donor predictions are both correct.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no circuit outcome access.

decision: A-D pass freezes the jointly capable rows for one separately preregistered reader-contracted selected-set test. Failure closes v22 without modifying rows or testing the circuit.
